prompt: A locked, grainy, desaturated wide view from a lens in the top corner of the shared bathroom, looking down at Brandon crouched awkwardly under the basin with one arm in a cast, his good hand on a pipe valve, brows raised, eyelids wide, mouth open, eyes aimed at the water. A fan of water bursts outward from the pipes, spreading in a bright sheet across the floor tiles and over his hoodie. A caged bulb overhead blows out the wet highlights, towels slump on the radiator, and his phone sits on the sink's edge with its face turned away. Colour is bleached, and nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
